title: Vanilla recipes create
description: this datapack adds recipes for create but make them all craftable with vanilla items
body:
this datapack adds recipes for create but make them all craftable with vanilla items, for now we have all the items related to the train tracks of create. but i will slowly add all of them, you can find all the recipes in either JEI or the wiki:
[wiki - Vanilla-recipes-create](https://simplycozy.miraheze.org/wiki/Data_Packs/Vanilla-recipes-create)
